claims.statement: The system employs a layered architecture where data flows from persistent database storage through application logic for business processing, and finally to the UI layer for content presentation and user interaction.
Reading sessions track user engagement and progress through content via persistent tracking of time and position.
AI-reader narratives are generated by processing raw content and streaming the synthetic results back to the user interface.
Content processing follows a pipeline of ingestion of raw material, normalization into a structured format, and enrichment with metadata or AI-generated segments via the extraction engine.
The system manages user sessions using express-session and enforces access control through requireAuth and requireOwner functions, as defined in src/auth.ts.
